description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to rescind the amount of CESS on eggs, fruit & Nuts that Published in Gaz. Ex. No. 2047/02
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order issued under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979 to rescind CESS amounts on various goods. It contains statutory instruments modifying existing regulations (cess rates on specific products), which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the regulatory action being taken rather than constituting a personnel appointment or detailed portfolio description that would trigger government classifications (Types 1-3).
